purpose: Separate useful lexical meanings from concrete historical images in six reused component families, and restore two already-scoped roots to their lexical or component role.

丁.reason: Fourth is the useful modern lexical value, while the graph's nail image is concrete and recurs through the phonetic family.

臣.reason: Minister is the useful lexical meaning; watchful eye preserves the eye pictograph already used consistently in descendants.

單.reason: Single is the common lexical meaning, while the whole graph historically depicts a hunting or military trap and should not be taught as an accidental modern-stroke decomposition.

番.reason: Turn is the useful lexical meaning, while the whole graph historically depicts an animal paw and should function as one concrete mnemonic unit.

昜.reason: Bright is the attested lexical meaning, while sunlight is the concrete whole-form image reused in descendants.

豈.reason: How is the useful lexical meaning, while the whole form depicts an upright celebratory drum associated with victory music.

交.reason: Cross is both the useful lexical sense and the action shown by the whole pictograph of a person with crossed legs.

丷.reason: This is a component label rather than ordinary vocabulary; split horns is already the consistent concrete image in all descendants.
